FAQ

Questions about retail outlet software

What should retail POS software include?

Fast GST billing, barcode inventory, multi-store stock, supplier purchase, loyalty and analytics. Sarvlekh combines them and connects to Tally for accounts.

Does it work offline?

Yes. Billing continues offline and syncs when the connection returns.

Can it run multiple outlets?

Yes. Manage stock transfers, pricing and reports across all outlets from one dashboard.

Can the retail outlet system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the retail outlet system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
